meanings.usage: 指从事灭火工作的专业人员，复数形式为firemen
指大面积的树木覆盖区域
指有权力的机构或部门，复数形式authorities指当局
英式英语拼写，美式英语为airplane
指一小块区域或与其他部分不同的区域
重量单位，several tons表示数吨

examples.en: Firemen had been fighting the forest fire for nearly three weeks.
examples.zh: 消防队员们与森林大火搏斗了将近三个星期。

phrases.usage: 表示得到控制、被控制住

examples.en: Before they could get it under control, the fire had spread widely.
examples.zh: 在他们能够控制住火势之前，大火已经蔓延开了。

examples.en: Great trees had covered the countryside for miles around.
examples.zh: 大树覆盖了周围数英里的乡村。

examples.en: In many places the grass had already taken root.
examples.zh: 在许多地方，草已经生了根。

examples.en: In place of the great trees, patches of green had begun to appear.
examples.zh: 在原来大树的地方，开始出现了片片绿色。

examples.en: Heavy rain would wash away the soil.
When the fire had at last been put out, the forest authorities ordered grass-seed.
examples.zh: 当大火终于被扑灭后，森林管理局订购了草籽。

examples.en: The forest authorities ordered several tons of a special type of grass-seed.
examples.zh: 森林管理局订购了好几吨一种特殊类型的草籽。

examples.en: The special grass-seed would grow quickly.
examples.zh: 这种特殊的草籽会快速生长。

phrases.usage: 表示来临、到来（用于季节）

examples.en: Winter was coming on and the hills threatened the surrounding villages.
examples.zh: 冬天即将来临，山丘威胁着周围的村庄。

grammar.title: 过去完成进行时 (Past Perfect Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时间点之前已经开始并持续到该时间点的动作，强调动作的持续性和进行过程 用于描述持续进行的动作到过去某一点，常与before、when等时间词连用

examples.en: Firemen had been fighting the forest fire for nearly three weeks before they could get it under control.
examples.zh: 消防队员们与森林大火搏斗了将近三个星期，才最终控制住火势。

examples.en: The planes had been planting seed for nearly a month when it began to rain.
examples.zh: 飞机已经播种了将近一个月，这时开始下雨了。

grammar.title: Before引导的时间状语从句
grammar.definition: before引导的从句表示主句动作发生在从句动作之前 强调主句动作先发生，或表示'在...之前'

examples.en: They could get it under control before they had been fighting for three weeks.
examples.zh: 他们能够控制住火势在他们搏斗三周之前。（此句语义有误，应为：在搏斗三周后，他们才控制住）

examples.en: A short time before, great trees had covered the countryside.
examples.zh: 不久之前，大树还覆盖着这片乡村。

grammar.title: 情态动词would的用法
grammar.definition: would在这里表示推测、可能性或过去的习惯性动作 用于描述过去将要发生的事或对过去的推测

examples.en: Heavy rain would not only wash away the soil but would cause serious floods as well.
examples.zh: 大雨不仅会冲走土壤，而且还会引起严重的洪水。

examples.en: This would be a disaster for the villages.
examples.zh: 这将对村庄造成一场灾难。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + had been + 动词-ing + for...before + 主语 + could + 动词原形

original.en: Firemen had been fighting the forest fire for nearly three weeks before they could get it under control.
original.zh: 消防队员们与森林大火搏斗了将近三个星期，才最终控制住火势。

imitations.en: She had been studying English for two years before she could pass the exam.
imitations.zh: 她学习了两年英语之后才通过了考试。

imitations.en: They had been waiting for the bus for an hour before it finally arrived.
imitations.zh: 他们等了一个小时的公交车，它终于来了。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + had been + 动词-ing + when + 主语 + 动词过去式

original.en: The planes had been planting seed for nearly a month when it began to rain.
original.zh: 飞机已经播种了将近一个月，这时开始下雨了。

imitations.en: I had been reading the book when my friend called me.
imitations.zh: 我正在看书，这时我朋友打电话给我。

imitations.en: He had been cooking dinner when the power went out.
imitations.zh: 他正在做晚饭，这时停电了。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + would + 动词原形 + not only...but (also)...

original.en: Heavy rain would not only wash away the soil but would cause serious floods as well.
original.zh: 大雨不仅会冲走土壤，而且还会引起严重的洪水。

imitations.en: Smoking would not only damage your health but would also waste your money.
imitations.zh: 吸烟不仅会损害你的健康，而且还会浪费你的钱。

imitations.en: The storm would not only destroy the houses but would also flood the fields.
imitations.zh: 暴风雨不仅会摧毁房屋，而且还会淹没农田。

patterns.pattern: In place of + 名词/名词短语, 主语 + 动词...

original.en: In place of the great trees which had been growing there for centuries, patches of green had begun to appear.
original.zh: 在原来生长了几个世纪的大树的地方，开始出现了片片绿色。

imitations.en: In place of the old bridge, a modern one has been built.
imitations.zh: 在旧桥的地方，一座现代化的桥已经建成了。

imitations.en: In place of coal, people now use gas for heating.
imitations.zh: 现在人们用天然气代替煤炭来取暖。

text.title: First listen and then answer the question.

lines.en: Firemen had been fighting the forest for nearly three weeks before they could get it under control.
lines.zh: 消防队员们同那场森林大火搏斗了将近3个星期才最后把火势控制住。

lines.en: A short time before, great trees had covered the countryside for miles around.
lines.zh: 就在不久之前，参天大树还覆盖着方圆数英里的土地。

lines.en: Now, smoke still rose up from the warm ground over the desolate hills.
lines.zh: 而现在，发热的地面上仍然升腾着烟雾，弥漫在荒凉的山丘上。

lines.en: Winter was coming on and the hills threatened the surrounding villages with destruction , for heavy rain would not only wash away the soil but would cause serious floods as well.
lines.zh: 冬季即将来临，这些山丘对周围的村庄具有毁灭性的威胁，因为大雨不仅会冲走土壤，而且还会引起严重的水灾。

lines.en: When the fire had at last been put out, the forest authorities ordered several tons of a special type of grass-seed which would grow quickly.
lines.zh: 在大火最后被扑灭后，森林管理当局订购了好几吨一种生长迅速的特殊类型的草籽。

lines.en: The seed was sprayed over the ground in huge quantities by aeroplanes .
lines.zh: 飞机把这种草籽大量地撒播在地上。

lines.en: The planes had been planting seed for nearly a month when it began to rain.
lines.zh: 飞机撒播近一个月后，开始下起雨来。

lines.en: By then, however, in many places the grass had already taken root.
lines.zh: 然而到那时，很多地方的草已经生了根。

lines.en: In place of the great trees which had been growing there for centuries patches of green had begun to appear in the blackened soil.
lines.zh: 一片片的绿草开始出现在这片烧焦的土地上，代替了多少世纪以来一直生长在那里的参天大树。

questions.q: What was the danger to the villages after the fire?
questions.zh: 大火之后，村庄面临的危险是什么？
questions.a: The hills threatened the surrounding villages with destruction, for heavy rain would not only wash away the soil but would cause serious floods as well.
questions.aZh: 这些山丘对周围的村庄构成了毁灭性的威胁：大雨不仅会冲走土壤，还会引起严重的水灾。

questions.q: Why is the past perfect progressive used in 'Firemen had been fighting the forest fire for nearly three weeks'?
questions.zh: 为什么要用过去完成进行时 had been fighting？
questions.a: Because it stresses an action that had been going on continuously for nearly three weeks before the past moment of getting the fire under control; 'had fought' would only state the fact.
questions.aZh: 因为它强调在“把火控制住”之前扑救已持续进行了近三周；had fought 只陈述事实。

questions.q: What picture does 'Now, smoke still rose up from the warm ground over the desolate hills' give, and why did the hills become dangerous in winter?
questions.zh: 这句描绘了怎样的景象？为什么山丘在冬季变得危险？
questions.a: It shows a burnt, desolate landscape. With no trees to hold it, heavy winter rain would wash away the soil and cause serious floods.
questions.aZh: 勾画出焦土荒山的画面：大树烧光，只剩发热冒烟的地面。树木不再固定土壤，冬雨一来就会冲走泥土并引发洪水。

questions.q: How does 'In place of the great trees which had been growing there for centuries, patches of green had begun to appear' show the recovery of the land?
questions.zh: 结尾句如何体现土地的恢复？
questions.a: 'Which had been growing there for centuries' is past perfect progressive, showing the trees had been growing for centuries before the fire; 'in place of' means instead of; 'blackened' is a past participle adjective meaning burnt black. New life was replacing the old trees.
questions.aZh: 过去完成进行时说明大树在火灾前已生长了数世纪；in place of 表示代替；blackened 意为烧焦的。新的生命正在取代古老的大树。

questions.q: Why did the forest authorities spray quick-growing grass-seed instead of planting young trees after the fire?
questions.zh: 为什么撒播速生草籽，而不直接种小树？
questions.a: Because winter was coming on and the danger was immediate: grass-seed could be sprayed by aeroplanes in huge quantities and would take root quickly, holding the soil before the heavy rain came. Planting trees would take far too long.
questions.aZh: 因为冬季将至，危险迫在眉睫：草籽可由飞机大量撒播、生根快，能在暴雨到来之前固定土壤；种树周期太长。

translation:
消防队员们同那场森林大火搏斗了将近3个星期才最后把火势控制住。
就在不久之前，参天大树还覆盖着方圆数英里的土地。
而现在，发热的地面上仍然升腾着烟雾，弥漫在荒凉的山丘上。
冬季即将来临，这些山丘对周围的村庄具有毁灭性的威胁，因为大雨不仅会冲走土壤，而且还会引起严重的水灾。
在大火最后被扑灭后，森林管理当局订购了好几吨一种生长迅速的特殊类型的草籽。
飞机把这种草籽大量地撒播在地上。
飞机撒播近一个月后，开始下起雨来。
然而到那时，很多地方的草已经生了根。
一片片的绿草开始出现在这片烧焦的土地上，代替了多少世纪以来一直生长在那里的参天大树。
title: After the Fire
subtitle: 大火之后

lead.question: 大火扑灭后，村庄面临的危险是什么？当局为何要空撒草籽？
lead.warmup: 一场森林大火烧了近三个星期才被控制住。火熄之后，真正的麻烦才刚开始：大树化为灰烬，土壤失去保护，冬天的暴雨一来，泥土就会被冲走，洪水将威胁周围的村庄。于是森林当局订购了好几吨速生草籽，用飞机大量撒播，赶在雨季之前让草生根。
goals: 用过去完成进行时 had been doing 描述扑救与撒播的持续过程
区分过去完成时与过去完成进行时，掌握过去完成时被动 had been put out
掌握 get ... under control、threaten ... with、take root、in huge quantities、in place of 等词组
用 not only ... but ... as well 表达大雨的双重后果
lead.summary: 消防队员奋战近三周才控制住森林大火，曾经覆盖方圆数英里的大树只剩荒凉山丘上腾起的烟雾。冬季将至，光秃的山丘以毁灭威胁周围村庄：大雨会冲走土壤、引发洪水。当局订购数吨速生草籽，用飞机大量撒播；撒播近一个月后天降大雨，而许多地方的草已经生根。
lead.tips: 过去完成进行时强调“一直在进行”；动作已完成、强调结果时只用过去完成时，所以火被扑灭是 had been put out。

exercises.q: 用所给动词的适当形式填空：When the fire ______ at last ______ ______ (put out), the forest authorities ordered several tons of grass-seed.
用括号内动词的适当形式填空：The planes ______ ______ ______ (plant) seed for nearly a month when it began to rain.
用 get ... under control 改写：Firemen could not control the fire until nearly three weeks had passed.
exercises.a: Firemen could not get it under control until nearly three weeks had passed.

exercises.q: 完成句子（飞机撒播草籽）：The grass-seed ______ ______ over the ground in huge ______ by aeroplanes.
选词填空（soil / ground）：Heavy rain would wash away the ______ from the desolate hills.
完成句子：这些山丘对周围的村庄具有毁灭性的威胁。The hills ______ the ______ villages with ______.
完成句子：By then, however, in many places the grass ______ already ______ ______.

quiz.q: 消防队员们同那场森林大火搏斗了多久才把火势控制住？
quiz.note: 首句 for nearly three weeks。

quiz.q: 冬季即将来临，这些山丘用什么威胁周围的村庄？
大火最后被扑灭后，是谁订购了好几吨速生草籽？
下列哪一句正确表达了“大雨不仅会冲走土壤，而且还会引起严重的水灾”？
options: Heavy rain would not only wash away the soil but would cause serious floods as well.
Heavy rain would wash away the soil or would cause serious floods.
Heavy rain washed away the soil as well as serious floods.
Not only heavy rain would wash away the soil but floods as well.

quiz.q: “然而到那时，很多地方的草已经生了根”的正确英文是？
options: In many places the grass had already taken place.
In many places the grass had already taken up.
In many places the grass had already taken root.
In many places the grass had already taken off.

quiz.q: 代替那些生长了数个世纪的参天大树，烧焦的土地上开始出现了什么？
